text:
Leyla (CS): Heads up — NexusTel (UAE regional telco) wants a short-term onboarding plan for a Ramadan promo. They need routing into a new ME region (me-central-1), partner IP allowlist, SSO/SAML enablement, and a temporary QPS bump for 2 weeks. Also flagged future Private deployment with KMS/HSM. Renewal note: customer said contract review may hinge on data residency paperwork.

Omar (NexusTel): yes, want to run a 10-day dev->prod promo, peak traffic windows 09:00-21:00 GST. Can we get a temporary lift to 1k QPS from baseline 250? IPs below are partner integrator endpoints. Also need SAML metadata exchange.

Priya (NetOps): send CIDRs and expected egress bandwidth. We can authorize region-level peering to me-central-1 but need to confirm peering PoP availability. Also, is TLS client cert pinning required?

Omar (NexusTel): CIDRs: 197.55.10.0/24, 197.55.11.45/32. Egress ~300Mbps peak. No client certs initially, will use token-based mTLS later.

Hannah (Solutions Eng): Suggest we: 1) create ephemeral allowlist entries for those CIDRs with auto-revoke after 2025-05-05T00:00:00Z; 2) grant temporary qps profile "promo-1k" scoped to me-central-1 + specific routes; 3) schedule a SAML setup call (30m) to exchange metadata and test login; 4) open Private deployment discovery ticket for Q3 (HSM/KMS requirements).

Noah (AE): flagging renewal risk — customer expects data residency confirmation and an audit artifact. Can CS/solutions capture a short note to attach to renewal playbook. I'll follow up with legal.

Leyla (CS): I'll book the enablement call for tomorrow 10:30 GST and prepare the runbook. Omar, can you confirm the exact service routes that need the lift (e.g., /v1/generate vs /v1/embeddings)?

Omar (NexusTel): primarily /v1/generate and a small number of embedding calls for personalization. Keep embeddings capped at 200 concurrent.

Priya (NetOps): provisioning checklist: 
- Create peering request for me-central-1
- Apply allowlist: 197.55.10.0/24, 197.55.11.45/32 (auto-revoke: 2025-05-05T00:00:00Z)
- Policy: promo-1k QPS, 09:00-21:00 GST, enforced by route tag nexus-promo
- Monitor: set alert at 75% of capacity and escalate to @Leyla

provision-bot: Provisioning ticket created: INF-4621. ETA for peering: 18h. Temporary QPS profile "promo-1k" applied in staging. Auto-revoke timer scheduled.

Hannah (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a minimal SAML test matrix to the ticket and include steps for enabling SSO in the Console: SAML ACS URL, SP EntityID, attribute mappings (email, name, org).

Leyla (CS): capture for renewal: customer asked for data residency proof (log bundle that shows region-specific storage) + written KMS isolation plan. Create a short doc and attach to renewal opportunity. Noah, can you own the doc?

Noah (AE): taking doc ownership. Will coordinate with Security for KMS isolation wording and attach by EOD tomorrow.

Omar (NexusTel): thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please mark the allowlist as temporary; we don't want permanent exposure.

Priya (NetOps): noted. Auto-revoke and audit trail will be enabled. I'll post the peering ticket link once the PoP is reserved.

Leyla (CS): :thumbsup: next steps recap in the ticket INF-4621 — peering + allowlist + promo profile + SAML call tomorrow 10:30 GST. Renewal doc assigned to Noah. If anything changes, ping this thread.

provision-bot: INF-4621 updates: peering PoP reserved in me-central-1 (JLT PoP). Staging config applied.

Omar (NexusTel): received, see you on the call.

(END)
